title: Pure Temple of the Kings
summary: Pure Temple of the Kings strategy built around continuous trap monsters and Odion's ancient Egyptian relics, powered by modern 2025 support. With Temple of the Kings and Treasures of the Kings enabling Traps to be activated the turn they are Set, the deck rapidly establishes Trap Monster swarms and unyielding spell/trap negates.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Man with the Mark adds Temple of the Kings or any card mentioning it from your Deck to your hand on Normal or Special Summon, and prevents itself, the Temple, and your Apophis monsters from being destroyed by card effects.

Treasures of the Kings counts as Temple of the Kings while in the Field Zone, Sets an Apophis Continuous Trap directly from your Deck that can be activated immediately, and searches a monster mentioning Temple of the Kings.
Temple of the Kings allows you to activate up to 2 Trap Cards during the turn they were Set, accelerating your entire backrow into immediate disruption.

Anubis the Last Judge sends itself from hand to the GY to search The Man with the Mark from your Deck, and Special Summons itself from the GY and destroys an opponent card when 3 or more Traps are in your GY.
Merciless Scorpion of Serket Special Summons itself by banishing a Level 10 monster, and searches Temple of the Kings or a Spell that mentions it.

summary.title: Opening: Treasures of the Kings
steps: Activate Treasures of the Kings in your Field Zone, which is treated as Temple of the Kings.
Use Treasures of the Kings to Set Apophis the Serpent directly from your Deck.
Activate Apophis the Serpent immediately thanks to Treasures of the Kings, Special Summoning it as a monster and Setting Apophis the Swamp Deity from your Deck.
Activate Apophis the Swamp Deity immediately, Special Summoning it as a monster and negating face-up cards your opponent controls up to the number of Continuous Traps you control.
Normal Summon The Man with the Mark to search Temple of the Kings and grant destruction immunity to your Temple and Apophis monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Divine Serpent Apophis is a Fusion Monster summoned using 2 Apophis monsters; it resets Apophis Continuous Traps from your GY to your field, and destroys 1 card on the field whenever a Trap Card is activated.

Apophis the Swamp Deity summons itself as a 2000 ATK/DEF Reptile monster and negates the effects of face-up cards your opponent controls up to the number of other Continuous Traps you control until the end of the turn.
Divine Scorpion Beast of Serket is a Fusion Monster that banishes a monster from your opponent's field or GY, providing non-destruction spot removal.

Verdict of Anubis negates the activation of an opponent's Spell or Trap Card that would destroy a Spell or Trap on the field, destroys all face-up monsters your opponent controls, and inflicts 500 damage for each monster destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Apophis the Serpent summons itself as a monster, Sets an Apophis Continuous Trap directly from your Deck, and searches Embodiment of Apophis when sent to the GY.
Defense of the Temple performs a Fusion Summon of an EARTH Fusion Monster using materials from your hand or field, and can use opponent monsters as material if you control Temple of the Kings.
Mystical Beast of Serket feeds into Temple of the Kings' ignition effect to cheat out high-powered bosses directly from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Ra's Dangers of the Divine, though mentionable via Defense of the Temple, belongs strictly in Egyptian God decks and is excluded here.
